result.guidanceOfficial:
The Company increased its target for revenue to 57.9 億美元 to 58.3 億美元
The Company increased its target for Adjusted EBITDA to 22.95 億美元 to 23.15 億美元
In February, the Company issued revenue and Adjusted EBITDA guidance of 56.75 億美元 to 57.75 億美元 and 22.4 億美元 to 22.9 億美元, respectively, for the full year 2026. In August, the Company raised its revenue and Adjusted EBITDA guidance to 57.75 億美元 to 58.25 億美元 and 22.75 億美元 to 23.05 億美元, respectively, for the full year 2026. Based on performance through the first nine months of the year and our visibility into and anticipated performance for the remainder of the year, the Company is raising its guidance and now expects full year 2026 revenue of 57.9 億美元 to 58.3 億美元 and Adjusted EBITDA of 22.95 億美元 to 23.15 億美元.
